title: Architecture Decisions and Technical Trade-Offs
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose and value of Architecture Decisions and Technical Trade-Offs.
Apply architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to a Python project scenario.
Identify decisions and trade-offs relevant to architecture decisions and technical trade-offs.
Review common mistakes and risks in architecture decisions and technical trade-offs.
Produce a verifiable project artifact using architecture decisions and technical trade-offs principles.

understand.concept: Architecture decisions record important choices about structure, dependencies, data flow and operational constraints. Choices involve trade-offs such as simplicity versus extensibility, local versus remote storage, and synchronous versus asynchronous work.
understand.whyItMatters: Recording decisions helps teams understand why a design exists and when it should be reconsidered.
understand.analogy: Choosing a route involves comparing distance, cost, safety and available transport.
understand.analogyLimit: A decision record does not make a choice permanently correct; evidence may justify revisiting it.
understand.summary: Architecture Decisions and Technical Trade-Offs helps learners plan and deliver maintainable Python projects.

explain.narrative: State the problem that requires a decision. Compare realistic options against project constraints. Record the selected option, rationale and consequences. Prefer the simplest design that meets current requirements and revisit choices when evidence changes.
